scripts.dev: wrangler pages dev --d1 DB --r2 BUCKET=buddymatters --compatibility-date=2024-09-01 -- npm run dev:vite
scripts.dev:dist: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --d1 DB --r2 BUCKET=buddymatters --compatibility-date=2024-09-01
scripts.d1:init: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=./migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=./migrations/0002_seed_data.sql
scripts.d1:init:remote: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file=./migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file=./migrations/0002_seed_data.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --branch=dev
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --branch=main
